name: Club Camellia ~Himitsu no Lesson 3 Days~
source:
Hayakawa Kazusa is a second-year attending a prestigious private school, Seiryou Academy. The company her father runs goes bankrupt, and the family loses everything. 
But Kazusa has another huge problem--that they can no longer afford to pay her school fees.
"I worked so hard to get into Seiryou, so there's no way I'm going to transfer to a public school! If that's the case, I'll pay for the school fees myself!"
So declared Kazusa to her mother, but there's no way a pampered, naïve princess like herself could amass enough money without affecting her studies.
Just when she was about to give up.
"Well, I do have a solution...try asking for Miyake-senpai in class 3-A."
At her best friend and classmate Ayumi's suggestion, Kazusa seeks help from the third-year Miyake, and goes to meet him.
"There is one, ya know? A part-time job where you can earn quite the hefty sum while still leaving time to study, just for the girls of Seiryou."
"I'll do it! So please tell me more about that job!"
At her wits' end, Kazusa, in the heat of the moment, requested to have the job introduced to her.
When she went to find out more details, Miyake's classmate, a female student called Minakami was awaiting her.
"Our group, 'Club Camellia', provides a service wherein we introduce girls to our clients."
But isn't that kinda bad... isn't that what you call being an escort?
It does feel rather dangerous, but you can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs. Now that I've come this far, I've gotta stick it out!
"Understood. I'll become a member."
Though Kazusa was determined to do it for the sake of paying for her school fees, there was one thing that bothered her.

"Now that I think about it, I, well... haven't done it with a guy before, is that alright?"

"......"
"......"
"......"
An awkward silence ensued. The one who broke it was Minakami.
"Then, how about this. During the three days before your first job, you'll take some special lessons."
"Lessons?"
"You have to gain that experience within three days. ...Amongst those three guys, choose one of them to be your partner, alright?"
Those three men were also students in the same class 3-A as Minakami, and associates of 'Club Camellia': Miyake, Narusawa and Shindou.
Amongst those three who seem to have a quirk or two, Kazusa has to choose one of them to be her partner.
"I, I understand. I have no choice but to rely on this place, so... I'll be in your care!"

Everything is for the sake of a happy school life. And now, the three-day lessons begin.

[Translated from the [url=http://polish.sakura.ne.jp/kikaku2011.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
早川和沙是就读于名门私立学校“成陵学园”的二年级学生。然而某一天，父亲经营的公司突然破产，一家人瞬间倾家荡产。
与此同时，和沙还面临着另一个天大的难题——家里再也无力承担她高昂的学费了。
“我可是拼了命才考进成陵的，绝对不要转去什么公立学校！既然如此，学费就由我自己来付！”
话虽在母亲面前说得豪迈，可像她这样从小娇生惯养、不谙世事的千金小姐，又怎么可能在不耽误学业的前提下凑齐那么一大笔钱呢？
就在她走投无路、几乎想要放弃的时候——
“办法嘛，我倒是有一个……你不妨去问问3年A班的三宅学长吧。”
在同班挚友步美的建议下，和沙前去向三年级的三宅学长求助。
“还真有这么一份差事哦？既不耽误学习，又能赚到一笔相当可观的收入——而且只招收成陵的女生。”
“我做！请务必告诉我这份兼职的详情！”
早已无计可施的和沙头脑一热，当场请求学长把这份工作介绍给自己。
等她前去打听具体内容时，在那里等候她的却是三宅的同班女同学——水上。
“我们‘山茶花俱乐部’提供的服务，就是把女孩介绍给客人们。”
可这听起来总觉得不太妙……这不就是所谓的援交陪侍吗？
虽然感觉相当危险，但事已至此，不入虎穴焉得虎子。既然已经走到这一步，也只能硬着头皮干下去了！
“我明白了，我愿意加入。”
尽管和沙为了赚取学费下定了决心，但心里还有一件事令她忐忑不安。

“仔细一想，我、那个……以前从来没有和男生做过那种事，这样也没关系吗？”

“……”
“……”
“……”
现场顿时陷入了一阵尴尬的沉默。率先打破沉默的是水上。
“既然这样，不如这么办吧。在正式接第一单工作前的这三天里，你先接受一番特别课程。”
“课程？”
“你必须在这三天之内积累好那方面的实战经验。……就在那三个男生当中，挑一个做你的搭档吧，明白了吗？”
那三名男生同样与水上同属3年A班，也是“山茶花俱乐部”的相关成员：三宅、鸣泽与进藤。
面对这三个性格似乎各有古怪的男生，和沙必须从中选出一人作为自己的指导搭档。
“我、我知道了。眼下我也只能指望这里了……还请多多关照！”

一切全都是为了保住幸福的校园生活。就这样，为期三天的秘密课程正式拉开了帷幕。

[译自[url=http://polish.sakura.ne.jp/kikaku2011.htm]官方网站[/url]]
